fixture.scene: project-generated Cornell-box product scene: seven fixed spheres, fixed binary BVH, fixed camera and Lambert materials

semantics.arithmetic: strict f32 after every arithmetic operation in both controlled targets
semantics.rng: xorshift32 seeded by seed xor pixel-index*0x9e3779b9 xor sample-index*0x85ebca6b; three draws per hemisphere sample and two per camera jitter
semantics.camera: origin (0,0,4.5), view plane z=0, vertical field scale 1.7, square aspect
semantics.intersection: fixed binary BVH depth-first, lower child first, sphere t tie resolved by lower primitive index, epsilon=0.001
semantics.sampling: normalize three signed uniform components and flip to surface hemisphere; zero vector maps to normal
semantics.bounce: Lambert throughput multiply; emitted radiance accumulated; maximum four intersections
semantics.russianRoulette: after bounce 2, continue probability max throughput clamped to [0.1,0.95], surviving throughput divided by probability
semantics.toneMap: c/(1+c), square-root gamma, clamp [0,1], round floor(x*255+0.5)
semantics.output: complete row-major RGBA8 framebuffer with alpha=255

oracle.crossTarget: complete RGBA8 comparison with maximum channel delta 64, mean delta 0.01 and outlier ratio 0.0002; exact counter values retained and intersection count tolerance 256
oracle.highPrecisionReference: independent f64 implementation of the same fixed scene, RNG, traversal and path rules
